motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Button, card, and modal transitions, 0.2s to 0.3s.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c2410c; color: #fff; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 16px 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9a3412; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(154, 52, 18, 0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #003366; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Sample kit on the navy hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #fff; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 16px 32px; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff6600; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Quote form field with the label above.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Open Sans, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #003366; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Open Sans, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #1f2937; caret-color: #003366; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #008080; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,128,128,0.15); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Fixed navy bar with the quote action.
components.html: OSM DECALSProducts
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; background: rgba(0,51,102,0.95); color: #fff; padding: 16px 24px; font-family: Open Sans, sans-serif; } .ds-word { font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-link { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover { color: #ff7518; } .ds-nav-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.html:
Industrial WHMIS Labels

Assembled and UV-laminated in Bonnyville.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.1); font-family: Open Sans, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,51,102,0.15); } .ds-card-photo { height: 160px; background: #003366; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; color: #003366; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.75; margin: 16px 24px 8px; } .ds-card-copy { color: #4b5563; margin: 0 24px 24px; }

components.name: Product Badge
components.description: UV-LAMINATED and similar tags on price cards.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: rgba(0, 51, 102, 0.1); color: #003366; font-family: Open Sans, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a shop counter, not a campaign. Navy holds the header, the hero scrim, and the materials band. Safety orange marks the words that name the work, and a deeper orange is reserved for buttons and the process numbers so white type stays readable. Photography is the shop's own: a lease truck, labels, hard hats, signs, and the three Rasks.

Density is a catalog. Prices, minimums, and the quote action sit in the same scroll as the photos. Motion is limited to hover lift, the modal, and focus. There is no dark theme. The owner asked to keep this world.
keyCharacteristics: Navy structure, orange action, teal as a second shop color
Montserrat headings, Open Sans body, both self-hosted (woff2: Montserrat 700/900, Open Sans 300/400/600)
Real product photos and a full-bleed lease-truck hero
Rates and minimums visible before the form
Soft corners: 4px badges, 8px controls, 12px cards, 16px contact and quote panels, full circles for process and team

rules.name: The Orange Job Rule
rules.body: #FF6600 is for large type on navy. Buttons and numbered steps use #C2410C. Small orange type on a light surface uses #9A3412.

rules.name: The Teal Job Rule
rules.body: #008080 is for fills and the focus ring. Small teal type on a light surface uses #115E59.

rules.name: The Same Face Rule
rules.body: Do not swap Montserrat or Open Sans, and do not insert a serif for emphasis.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset and navy or brown tinted. Do not add a zero-offset orange halo.

dos: Do keep the lease-truck photo behind the hero, with a navy scrim strong enough for the H1.
Do keep one quote button label, Request a Quote, and let each button open its own modal.
Do use the deeper action orange wherever white type sits on orange.
donts: Don't add a dark mode or a second accent family.
Don't rewrite the H1, prices, or team lines as part of a visual pass.
Don't put small white type on #FF6600.
